## What is uv?

`uv` is "An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust."[^1]

I've been using `uv` for some projects and I really notice an improvement in the velocity when I'm installing Python packages in comparison with another tools like `pip`. For example in the @fig-perfomance we can see the different in time installing the same package with different packages manager where `uv` is the fastest.

![Installing Trio's dependencies with a warm cache. Source: <https://docs.astral.sh/uv/>](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/assets/1309177/03aa9163-1c79-4a87-a31d-7a9311ed9310#only-dark){fig-align="center" #fig-perfomance}

## Installation and configuration

We have different options to install `uv` go ahead to the documentation [Installing uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) to find the best option for you project.


## Usage

### Basic commands

Install specific Python version
```Bash
uv python install 3.12 3.11
```

List Python versions installed
```Bash
uv python list
```

Run a Python script
```Bash
uv run script.py
```

### Start a project

Starting a project will create the following files:

- main.py
- pyproject.toml
- uv.lock
- .python-version

Commands:
```Bash
# Start the project hello-world
uv init hello-world

# Start the project hello-world with Python 3.12
uv init hello-world --python 3.12

# Usage the current folder as a project
uv init

# Execute the project
uv run main.py 
```

### Working with virtual environments

Create a virtual environment (this command will create `.venv` folder)
```Bash
uv venv
```

Installing packages on the `.venv`
```Bash
# A package
uv pip install PACKAGE_NAME

# A requirements.txt
uv pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Activate the virtual environment for `Bash` and `ZSH` shell
```Bash
source .venv/bin/activate
```




### Dependencies management

Add a public library with specific version
```Bash
uv add 'request==2.31.0'
```

Add a library using git repository (could be useful for private repositories)
```Bash
uv add git.https://github.com/...
```

Install with requirements.txt and constraints.txt files
```Bash
uv add -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt
```

Remove packages
```Bash
uv remove requests
```

### Running servers

Run a flask server
```Bash
uv run -- flask run -p 3000
```

Run a quarto server in localhost
```Bash
uv run -- quarto preview mysite --port PORT --host 0.0.0.0
```

Render quarto document
```Bash
uv run -- quarto render mysite
```

### Using integrations

Using Jupyter Lab[^Jupyter]
```Bash
uv run --with jupyter jupyter lab
```

Using Docker Images with `uv` installed [^Docker]
```Bash
docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:debian uv --help
```


[^1]: <https://docs.astral.sh/uv/>
[^Docker]: <https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/integration/docker/>
[^Jupyter]: <https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/integration/jupyter/>
